description: Compare a current loan's remaining payments against a new refinanced loan on the same outstanding balance, and compute the monthly savings and the break-even month where cumulative monthly savings recoup the closing costs.

currentBalance.description: Outstanding balance on the current loan

currentRatePercent.description: Current loan's annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 6.5

currentRemainingMonths.description: Months remaining on the current loan

newRatePercent.description: New (refinanced) loan's annual interest rate as a percent, e.g. 5.5

name: calculate_loan_refinance
